prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1418; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with the rear-end collision in which they were injured. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or any other means. Kindly confirm in writing that you have received this notice and that your file has been opened.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, together with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply, and that you provide a certified copy of the declarations page. We also ask that you preserve all evidence relating to the incident, including the claim file, recorded statements, photographs, vehicle data, repair estimates, and any dashcam or telematics records. Please ensure that no such materials are altered, discarded, or repaired without prior notice to this office. We look forward to your prompt response.
